validity.recommendation: No action on existence/length/cost/route; keep monitoring for a formal approval/开工 announcement.
validity.researcher_notes: This is a real, well-documented pipeline proposal, not a phantom entity. The sheet's own Status/Length/SegmentCost ref (gx.cnr.cn, 2025-01-17) is a 央广网 (CNR) article titled '韩凯：建设防城港至东兴天然气支线管道' quoting Han Kai, Party Secretary/Director of the Fangchenggang Development & Reform Commission, at the 2025 Guangxi 'two sessions': he recommends building a Fangchenggang-to-Dongxing natural gas branch pipeline, 'quan chang yue 40 gongli, zong touzi yue 8000 wan yuan' (total length ~40 km, total investment ~80 million yuan) and urges relevant departments to put it in the 2025 construction-start plan. Both numbers match GEM exactly (LengthKnown=40 km; SegmentCost=80,000,000 RMB, 2025). Route (Fangchenggang -> Dongxing, both within Fangchenggang prefecture-level city; Dongxing is administratively a county-level city under Fangchenggang) matches GEM's Start/End location fields. Fuel=Gas is trivially correct (explicitly 天然气 in every source). The article's own framing ('I recommend expediting construction ... and including it in the 2025 construction-start plan') shows this is a legislative RECOMMENDATION, not yet an approved/funded project -- consistent with GEM's Status='proposed'. Found the identical story re-syndicated at news.qq.com/rain/a/20250117A01W2T00 (same quotes, same date) -- useful as a second working URL but it is the SAME wire story, not an independent source, per the corroboration rule (does not upgrade tier past medium). Checked the 43-pipeline Guangxi roster for a duplicate/relabel: no other row shares a Fangchenggang<->Dongxing route. Also found a separate, unrelated ~70 km 'China-Myanmar pipeline Fangchenggang branch duplicate line' (Qinzhou->Fangchenggang, 406.4mm, 0.68 bcm/y, EIA-stage news from Apr-May 2026) that also serves the Fangchenggang gas market but runs a different route (Qinzhou-based, does not reach Dongxing) and is a larger trunk project distinct from this local ~40 km branch -- ruled out as a duplicate.

Re-verify ProposalYear/ProposalMonth (currently 2021/3). Its sole ref, news.bjx.com.cn/html/20210326/1144324-4.shtml, is blocked by an anti-bot CAPTCHA/obfuscation wall on every fetch method tried (direct curl in multiple encodings, WebFetch, Jina.ai reader proxy, Wayback Machine has no snapshot older than today) -- its actual content cannot be confirmed to discuss this specific 40 km Fangchenggang-Dongxing segment. There is also a chronology tension: the only content-verifiable source (2025-01-17, CNR/QQ) frames this exact 40km/RMB80M project as a brand-new recommendation a representative is pushing for the FIRST time, urging its inclusion in the 2025 construction-start plan, with no reference to a 2021 precedent -- which is odd if the project had already been formally proposed 4 years earlier. Plausible explanations: (a) bjx's 2021 article is a broader/generic Guangxi gas-network planning piece and ProposalYear was attributed to this row from network-level content rather than this specific branch, or (b) there were genuinely two separate proposal events (2021 then a 2025 renewed push) and 2021 is correct. Cannot resolve from the source as currently inaccessible.

validity.recommendation: Low-priority: confirm PipelineType='transmission' is intentional network convention (matches sibling 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network' rows in the roster) rather than a mis-classified local distribution branch.
validity.researcher_notes: PipelineType's sole ref is the same inaccessible bjx.com.cn page (see spec concern above), so it cannot be independently checked. The only readable description of this pipeline (CNR/QQ, 2025-01-17) calls it a '支线管道' (branch pipeline) whose purpose is to supply residential/commercial/industrial gas demand to Dongxing -- language more typical of a distribution feeder than a long-haul transmission trunk. However every other segment in the 43-pipeline Guangxi roster under the same 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network' umbrella name appears to use the same transmission classification for comparably short branch lines, so this may simply be this dataset's standing convention rather than an error specific to P7661 -- flagging for awareness, not recommending a unilateral change.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest dated evidence found is 2025-01-17 (CNR, re-syndicated same-day at QQ News): a Fangchenggang district official publicly recommends the government build this pipeline and include it in the 2025 construction-start plan -- i.e. as of the most recent evidence, it is STILL only a recommendation, not an approved/funded/under-construction project. Searched for any later news (construction start, bidding/tender notices, EIA filings) specific to this Fangchenggang-Dongxing branch through mid-2026 and found none (only unrelated Fangchenggang-area infrastructure: a Fangchenggang-Dongxing railway expansion, and a separate China-Myanmar pipeline Fangchenggang branch duplicate line project). Elapsed time from evidence date (2025-01) to now (2026-07) is ~1.5 years, under the 2-year proposed->shelved dormancy threshold, so Status='proposed' stays correct for now; it is worth re-checking again after Jan 2027 if still no construction news.

summary: P7661 (Fangchenggang-Dongxing gas branch, Guangxi) is a real, well-sourced proposal -- length (40km) and cost (RMB80M) both confirmed via an independent-origin 2025-01-17 CNR story (also re-syndicated at QQ News); Status='proposed' holds and is under the 2y dormancy threshold. Two low/medium-severity concerns staged: ProposalYear=2021 rests on a bjx.com.cn ref that is completely inaccessible (CAPTCHA-walled) and sits in tension with the 2025 story's framing as a brand-new proposal; and PipelineType='transmission' is likewise unverifiable from that same dead ref, though consistent with sibling rows' convention.
